thread:
maya: Quick sync — opened PR to rotate the app HSM key + audit-log schema bump. We need 2 approvals (sec + infra) and an SRE window. Target merge = Thu 02:00 UTC during maintenance slot. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9876

sam: Taking a look now. quick note: CI is failing on lint for scripts/rotate_keys.sh :eyes:

jordan: Link to runbook update? we should include HSM operator steps and rollback checklist before merge.

maya: Good call. I created a short runbook edit, added the key-transfer operator steps and rollback commands: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/hsm-rotation.md#pr-9876 — please review.

alex: SRE: we need ~30m of HSM operator time and to schedule a canary in us-west-2 first. Also call out measurable audit events (key_id rotation event).

sam: Found lint issue: missing shebang + `set -e` in scripts/rotate_keys.sh. small fix in next commit.

maya: Thanks — do you want me to push that or you?

sam: I'll push a one-line commit.

ci-bot: [ci/checks] build: failed — scripts/rotate_keys.sh lint error

sam: Pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9876/commits/ab12cd3 — added `#!/usr/bin/env bash` and `set -e`.

ci-bot: [ci/checks] build: success — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

jordan: Read runbook update, added a small note about post-rotation audit verification commands. Once CI is green I can +1.

maya: Thanks. tagging @sam @jordan for approvals. Also cc @alex for SRE go/no-go.

sam: LGTM from runtime side, code change is tiny and well scoped. +approve :thumbsup:

alex: SRE provisional ok — schedule looks fine, please notify ops 30m before merge. I'll join the HSM operator call.

jordan: Approving after runbook tweak. +approve :white_check_mark:

maya: Great — merging at Thu 02:00 UTC. Notifying incident-ops and SRE. Will run canary in us-west-2, then full rollout.

sam: Can you add a short note in the PR description about the smoke-check commands? saves a follow-up.

maya: Done — added smoke-checks and expected audit log lines.

alex: :pray: Thanks all.

maya: Merge complete during window. Post-merge: verify audit entries and rotate service tokens if needed. Leaving follow-up tasks in the PR.
